calibration_sources: MoonshotAI Kimi Moonlight (Muon is Scalable for LLM Training: 2D Distributed Muon + RMS-Matched Weight Decay)
KellerJordan Muon (5-Step Quintic Newton-Schulz Orthogonalization & min(m,n) Gram Matrix Transpose)
SOAP (Shampoo with Adam in Preconditioner Eigenbasis) & bitsandbytes 8-Bit Blockwise Optimizer Benchmarks

workload.model_and_cluster: 72B Parameter LLM across 512x H100 SXM5 GPUs (FSDP=64 x TP=8, Step Time = 3,850 ms)
workload.convergence_target: Reach target validation cross-entropy Loss = 1.85 (requires 10.0 Trillion tokens on baseline AdamW)

tiers.name: Tier 1: 标准混合精度 FP32 AdamW (12 Bytes/Param 显存占用 · 坐标级独立更新基线)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Standard Mixed-Precision FP32 AdamW (12 Bytes/Param · 1.00x Token Efficiency)
tiers.optimizer_mechanism: FP32 master weight (4B) + FP32 first moment m (4B) + FP32 second moment v (4B)
tiers.spectral_update_behavior: Coordinate-wise division m/sqrt(v) ignores matrix singular spectrum; top singular directions dominate
tiers.recommended_for: Default baseline for small/medium runs and 1D Embedding/LM-Head/RMSNorm parameters.

tiers.name: Tier 2: 分块动态量化 8-Bit AdamW / Adafactor (显存减半至 6 Bytes/Param · 不加速收敛)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Block-Wise 8-Bit Quantized AdamW / Adafactor (6 Bytes/Param · 0.99x Efficiency)
tiers.optimizer_mechanism: 2048-element block-quantized INT8/FP8 moments (1B m + 1B v) + FP32 master weight (4B)
tiers.spectral_update_behavior: Saves 50% optimizer state VRAM, but provides zero sample-efficiency speedup over standard AdamW
tiers.recommended_for: Memory-constrained fine-tuning on consumer/workstation GPUs; does not reduce pretraining token bill.

tiers.name: Tier 3: 分布式二阶 Kronecker 预条件器 (Distributed Shampoo / SOAP · 特征分解开销高)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: Distributed Second-Order Kronecker Preconditioner (Shampoo / SOAP · 1.28x Efficiency)
tiers.optimizer_mechanism: Kronecker factor matrices L, R + periodic FP32 eigendecomposition / matrix inverse roots
tiers.spectral_update_behavior: Rotates gradients into eigenbasis to accelerate convergence (1.28x), but adds 14B/param & FP32 SVD stalls
tiers.recommended_for: Research benchmarks exploring full second-order curvature where FP32 SVD latency is acceptable.

tiers.name: Tier 4: 2D 分布式 Muon (5步 BF16 Newton-Schulz 矩阵正交化) + Embedding AdamW (Kimi Moonlight 范式)
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: 2D Distributed Muon (5-Step BF16 Newton-Schulz) + Embed/Head AdamW (1.38x Efficiency)
tiers.optimizer_mechanism: Single BF16 momentum (2B) + FP32 master (4B) + 5-step quintic BF16 Tensor-Core Newton-Schulz on 2D weights
tiers.spectral_update_behavior: Snaps all gradient singular values to ~1.0 (UV^T) in 42.5ms via min(m,n) Gram transpose, boosting token efficiency 1.38x
tiers.recommended_for: Production foundation model pretraining (Dense & MoE) seeking 1.38x fewer tokens (-$1.12M GPU bill) and -50% optimizer VRAM.
